title: The Dead Letter Sack
logline: An aging packet boat skipper hoards undelivered probate mail from an abandoned mining hub to shield his deceased partner's adopted daughter from being disinherited.

roles.description: Runs a defunct independent packet boat route; stubborn, arthritic, protective of old debts.
Biological kin claiming a deceased miner's estate before the dead man's foster children learn of the death.
An armed repossession cutter hired by dock creditors to seize the veteran's packet boat and its cargo.
A decommissioned orbital postal buoy where undelivered probate packets have gathered dust for years.
The system probate magistrate's intake dock where testament cylinders are formally unsealed.

public_situation: An obsolete mail tender docked at {role:dead_letter_depot} holds thirty years of undelivered letters from abandoned fringe claims, and creditors are moving to impound the hull.
private_truth: {role:packet_veteran} deliberately buried a dying partner's true testament to prevent an estranged biological relative from stripping the foster family's refinery share.

beats.public_change: Bailiffs post an impound notice on the postal buoy, giving thirty-six hours before the dead-letter locker is auctioned off.

missions.reason: He pays the pilot to collect a sealed lead-lined probate dispatch pouch from the depot vault before court bailiffs lock the hatch.
missions.private_fact: The pouch holds the holographic seal of a deceased prospector whose estate is being quietly liquidated without his heirs knowing.

beats.public_change: The biological heir arrives in the system demanding the immediate release of all sealed succession cylinders.

missions.reason: She hires the pilot to scan the probate registry intake terminal to prove that the deceased prospector's probate dispatch was illegally suppressed.
missions.private_fact: She bought the debt paper on the veteran's ship specifically to force the postal vault open before the statutory claim deadline expires.

beats.public_change: An armed debt recovery cutter takes up position across the approach corridor to intercept the veteran's skiff.

missions.reason: The creditor cutter has ambushed the route between the depot and the registry; the veteran needs the interdiction broken so the letters reach safe hands.
missions.private_fact: The cutter captain offers to clear the veteran's ship debt and pay cash if the pilot surrenders the sealed probate pouch.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the repossession cutter and delivers the probate pouch to the foster family.
resolutions.summary: {role:packet_veteran} keeps his ship. The deceased prospector's foster children retain their claim, and the biological heir's petition is dismissed.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot ran an armed blockade to deliver probate mail that saved an adopted family's home.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the cutter captain's buyout offer and surrenders the probate pouch.
resolutions.summary: {role:probate_claimant} acquires the probate pouch. The foster kin are evicted from the refinery claim, and {role:packet_veteran} is left without a route.

consequences.public_summary: Word spread that a courier sold thirty years of private probate mail to debt collectors for quick scrip.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot refuses all contracts or ignores the repossession standoff.
resolutions.summary: Bailiffs breach the postal depot. The probate packets are auctioned for paper scrap, leaving the disputed refinery claim in limbo.

loose_threads.detail: The wax seal on the probate cylinder bears a notary registration number that was retired ten years before the signature date.
The debt note on the veteran packet boat was purchased at ninety percent discount by an anonymous clearing account.
The probate registry terminal records a three-hour power blackout on the night the disputed prospector died.

radio_hooks: Creditors petition probate court to liquidate obsolete mail pods at {role:dead_letter_depot}.
{role:district_registry} reminds prospector heirs that unclaimed estate filings expire at cycle end.
Independent packet skiff cited for unpaid mooring fees near {role:dead_letter_depot}.

voice_direction.packet_veteran: Speaks in gravelly fragments with long pauses between sentences. Avoids naming the deceased or the foster daughter.
voice_direction.probate_claimant: Crisp, legalistic, fast-cadenced speech. Emphasizes bloodlines, property statutes, and rightful contractual succession.
